title: 湾岸フロウ
caption: Japanese city pop and AOR blended with smooth early 1990s hip hop. Laid-back male rap verses in Japanese, low and conversational; a silky male falsetto sings the chorus with layered harmonies. Mid-tempo head-nodding drum machine groove, deep round synth bass, glassy digital electric piano, clean chorus-effect guitar licks, shimmering synth pads, a smooth alto saxophone answering the vocal. A night drive on the bayside expressway, cool sea air, city lights sliding past. Polished, glossy studio production.
